recognize_zh: 結膜組織被中型、染色質細緻、細胞質稀少的單一形態母細胞瀰漫浸潤，免疫染色 CD4、CD56、CD123、TCL1 皆瀰漫陽性，流式細胞儀顯示 CD45 弱、HLA-DR+、TdT+、CD34 陰性，組合起來指向母細胞性漿細胞樣樹突細胞腫瘤（BPDCN）。
features: Diffuse monotonous infiltrate of medium-sized blastoid cells effacing conjunctival stroma (panel B)
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin, small nucleoli and scant cytoplasm; high N:C ratio
Interspersed thin fibrovascular stroma without epithelial nests or necrosis in this field
Diffuse strong positivity for CD4, CD56, CD123 and TCL1 by IHC (panels C-F), with perivascular sparing of vessel walls
Flow cytometry (panel A): CD45-dim, low-SSC population expressing CD4, CD56, HLA-DR and cytoplasmic TdT, negative for CD34, with dim CD117
describe_en: Conjunctival biopsy shows diffuse infiltration by sheets of monotonous medium-sized blastoid cells with finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous to small nucleoli and scant cytoplasm. By immunohistochemistry the neoplastic cells are diffusely positive for CD4, CD56, CD123 and TCL1. Flow cytometry of the lesion identifies a CD45-dim, low side-scatter population expressing CD4, CD56, HLA-DR and TdT without CD34, CD3, CD19 or MPO. Findings are consistent with blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm involving the ocular adnexa.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation (myeloid sarcoma)
ddx.vs: Monocytic AML can be CD4+/CD56+ but usually expresses lysozyme, CD14/CD11c or MPO and lacks the strong CD123/TCL1/TCF4 co-expression of BPDCN.
ENKTL is CD56+ but angiodestructive, cytoplasmic CD3ε+, cytotoxic granule-positive and EBER-positive, unlike this EBER-negative CD123+/TCL1+ infiltrate.
Lymphoblastic lymphoma is TdT+ like this case but expresses CD3 or CD19/PAX5 and lacks CD123/TCL1 co-expression with CD4/CD56.
Merkel cell carcinoma is CD56+ but cytokeratin 20 dot-positive and CD45-negative.

stain: H&E; IHC: CD4, CD56, CD123, TCL1; flow
